thread:
Alex: Quick little experiment—if you could mail your future self a three-song mixtape (one song that captures today, one that comforts, one that makes you laugh), what would you put on it? I'll start.
Maria: Love this. 1) Alvvays - Archie, Marry Me (today) 2) Sade - No Ordinary Love (comfort) 3) Flight of the Conchords - Business Time (lol) :joy:
Sam: Nice. My picks: 1) The National - I Need My Girl 2) Otis Redding - (Sittin' On) The Dock of the Bay 3) Smash Mouth - All Star (guilty pleasure) :grimacing:
Jordan: Okay sentimental mode: 1) Bon Iver - Holocene 2) Joni Mitchell - Both Sides Now 3) Daft Punk - Get Lucky (cheer-up) :sunglasses:
Tara: I'm doing eras: 1) Lizzo - Good as Hell (today, hype) 2) Elliott Smith - Between the Bars (comfort, heavy) 3) The Lonely Island - I'm On a Boat (laugh) :boat:
Alex: Context: I'm imagining slipping this into a letter and burying it in a shoebox :shoe: also curious if folks would actually listen 30 years from now.
Maria: @Alex I'd probably cry on track 2 and then laugh on track 3. Please audio-hold my future self.
Sam: Also, tiny UX question—should we collect these on a shared playlist? DevBot, can you make one?
DevBot: Created playlist "three-song-time-capsule" and invited channel. Link: https://redwood.example/playlist/3songcapsule :robot_face:
Jordan: Ooh, perfect. I'll add mine now.
Tara: Suggestion: make this a monthly mini-ritual, like a five-minute Friday thing. Low effort, high heart.
Alex: Monthly works better for me too. Fridays feel like too much pressure to be clever.
Maria: Agree monthly. Who volunteers to DM me if we forget? :raised_hand:
Sam: I'll do reminders for March and April. :calendar:
Jordan: This turned into wholesome internet energy. Love it. :heart:
Tara: Same. Also, if anyone actually wants a physical mixtape, I'll burn a CD and mail it. Retro points.
Alex: Deal. If Tara ships physical tapes I will donate shoeboxes.
Maria: (reacts :heart:)
Sam: :100:
